summary: IX Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting an adjourned extraordinary general meeting held October 7, 2026, at which holders approved the Fifth Extension Amendment Proposal 4,268,632-for to 13-against and ratified the auditor. Roughly 435,000 shares were tendered for redemption in connection with the vote. As of the September 15, 2026 record date, 4,703,164 Class A and 1,747,879 Class B shares were entitled to vote, with 66.17% represented at the meeting. Watch the redemption rate and remaining trust size ahead of the new deadline.
